content: OpenCode custom tools (opencode.ai/docs/custom-tools): .opencode/tools/ or ~/.config/opencode/tools/; filename=tool name; multiple exports -> <filename>_<exportname>; tool() helper from @opencode-ai/plugin or plain object {description,args,execute} with own zod import; tool.schema is zod; execute(args, context) where context = {agent, sessionID, messageID, directory, worktree}; examples return strings. Note sessionID capitalization differs from PRD sessionId.
